text:
maya: hey team — we're seeing a spike of 503s originating from the acme org on model `acme-gen`, route `v2-generate` in eu-west-1 since last night's deploy. can someone point me to the saved search/dashboard that filters by org/model/route/region/status? want to grab logs + traces and save a query so product can triage.

jon: try this LogSearch query pasted into the query bar, then save it as a preset: 
```
org:acme AND model:acme-gen AND route:v2-generate AND region:eu-west-1 AND status:503
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```
This will show the raw logs. For traces, use the APM view (see below). Quick dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/logs?org=acme&query=status%3A503%20model%3Aacme-gen%20route%3Av2-generate&region=eu-west-1

alex: i can create the saved search and add a dashboard tile. thinking of naming it `acme-gen / v2-generate / 503 / eu` (human-friendly). want me to also create a short URL or an org-level saved preset? @maya which teams should have read access?

sam: for alerting, i'd suggest tuning to avoid noisy pages during deploys. alarm idea (pseudo rule):
```
name: acme-gen-503-eu-alert
condition: (sum(status:5xx) / sum(total_requests)) > 0.02 AND sum(status:5xx) > 5
window: 5m
recovery: 10m
mute_tags: deploy:recent
notify: #oncall-sre (pager after-hours)
```
That triggers only for sustained, meaningful error rates. We can adjust the percentage or absolute count after a few incidents.

jon: to find related traces quickly in APM run something like: 
```
service:inference route:"v2-generate" response_code:503 | top trace_id by count
```
Then jump from trace -> logs to see the exact exception.

alex: created saved search: `acme-gen / v2-generate / 503 / eu` (id: ss-1802-9). public to acme org + infra team. link: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/saved-searches/ss-1802-9

maya: amazing, thanks. can we also wire the alert to slack only for daytime and pager at night? i.e., send to #acme-oncall during 18:00-08:00 -> pager.

alex: yup — i'll create the alert but will hold pager hook until you confirm escalation window. adding `notify: #acme-oncall (slack day) + pager (night)` — will mute for 15m on deploy tag. :thumbsup:

eng-sre-bot: Saved search created: ss-1802-9 (acme-gen / v2-generate / 503 / eu). Alert draft created: acme-gen-503-eu-alert (awaiting final approval).

maya: perfect — can you also snapshot a few sample log IDs for the incident so product can see examples? would be helpful for the postmortem.

alex: done — added three sample event IDs to the saved search description and pinned the dashboard tile. i'll leave the alert draft in the infra queue for final tweak. ping me if you want the pager enabled now. :white_check_mark:
